fields.options: Credentials are stored encrypted on the server (Frappe's Password fieldtype, backed by __Auth) and are never included in any response sent to the browser. Get sandbox credentials at superpdp.tech. SIRET fields are used only to build the UBL routing identifiers required by SuperPDP - they are not secret.
